description: This file defines a class 'Image' within the OpenCart system, providing functionalities for image manipulation such as loading, resizing, cropping, rotating, saving, watermarking, and other image processing operations.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A class providing various image manipulation methods such as resizing, cropping, watermarking, and saving images.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Image object, loads image info, and loads the image resource based on MIME type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename of the image.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns the bits information of the image.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the image to a file, choosing the format based on file extension.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the image maintaining aspect ratio according to specified width, height, and default parameter.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Applies a watermark image at a specified position.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops the image to specified top-left and bottom-right coordinates.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the image by a specified degree.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies a filter to the image (private method).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Adds text to the image (private method).

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another image onto this image (private method).

methods.name: html2rgb
methods.description: Converts HTML color code to RGB array.
